title: Biquadrate

inlines.v: BIQUAD'RATE, n. [L. bis, twice, and quadratus, squared.] In mathematics the fourth power, arising from the multiplication of a square number or quantity by itself. Thus 4x4=16, which is the square of 4, and 16x16=256, the biquadrate of that number.
